english.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
english.text:
The planet closest to the Sun is **Mercury**.

It orbits the Sun in just 88 Earth days and has no atmosphere to retain heat, making its surface temperatures vary drastically between day and night. Despite being the smallest planet in our solar system, its proximity to the Sun makes it the hottest planet overall (due to the lack of atmosphere to reflect heat away, Venus is actually hotter, but Mercury is the closest).
